name: Maria De Los Angeles Gonzalez
office: Lennox School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Maria De Los Angeles Gonzalez is the president of the Lennox School District Governing Board. In a 2026 district message, she described education as a shared responsibility to develop children who can think, act, and lead with values.
